trips.name: Teotihuacán Pyramids
trips.geocode_query: Zona Arqueológica de Teotihuacán, San Juan Teotihuacán, State of Mexico, Mexico
trips.description: Walk the Avenue of the Dead and climb the Pyramids of the Sun and Moon at one of Mesoamerica's greatest ancient cities, reached by direct bus from Terminal Central del Norte.

trips.name: Puebla
trips.geocode_query: Centro Histórico de Puebla, Puebla, Mexico
trips.description: Explore the UNESCO-listed colonial centre, its Talavera-tiled churches, the Zócalo and the Rosary Chapel, and try mole poblano and cemitas, via frequent ADO buses from TAPO.

trips.name: Taxco
trips.description: Wander the steep cobbled streets of this whitewashed silver-mining town, visit Santa Prisca church and shop for silver jewellery, reached by direct bus from Terminal Central del Sur.
